identitySignals: Agenda names 'City of Oakland - KIDS FIRST! Oakland Fund for Children and Youth'; the official OFCY site (ofcy.org) describes the Oakland Fund for Children and Youth as a City of Oakland initiative in the Human Services Department, with a matching name
Located in Oakland, CA (150 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza), matching the agenda location
Its purpose, grantmaking for Oakland children and youth, matches OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' grant agreements where the City is the funder
research.notes: Public agency (City of Oakland program), so no EIN, CA entity number or SAM UEI. The grantor is the City of Oakland; OFCY is not a separate legal entity.

profile.address: 150 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza, Suite 4216, Oakland, CA 94612
profile.legalName: Oakland Fund for Children and Youth
profile.summary: The Oakland Fund for Children and Youth (OFCY) is a City of Oakland program in the Human Services Department, Children and Youth Services Division. It is the city's largest grantmaking program. It funds services for Oakland children and youth from birth to age 21.
